patch:
--- a/src/trustsight/differ/_sources.py
+++ b/src/trustsight/differ/_sources.py
@@ -94,6 +94,7 @@
     return ""
 
 _URL_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s\'\"\)]+")
+_URL_SCALAR_RE = re.compile(r"\s*url\s*=")
 
 def extract_urls_from_diff(diff_text: str) -> SourceChanges:
     """Extract added and removed URLs from a diff."""
--- a/src/trustsight/differ/_sources.py
+++ b/src/trustsight/differ/_sources.py
@@ -139,6 +139,8 @@
         resolved = resolve_text(body, new_table if prefix == "+" else old_table)
         if "http" not in resolved:
             continue
+        if _URL_SCALAR_RE.match(resolved):
+            continue
         # A line that only prints text (``echo``/``printf``/``cat``/``tee``)
         # names no source; harvesting its URL fed H003, C011, the buckets and
         # novelty a URL no fetch ever touches.  Anything else is kept: a bare
rationale: url= is the homepage a reader follows, not a source the build fetches. Scoring it as a source URL made a homepage edit look like a novel fetch target.
tp_twin: a URL added to source=() is still a novel source
